# PackRip: Cards — booster pack opening simulator for iPhone

> PackRip: Cards is a native SwiftUI iPhone pack-opening simulator iOS app by Arinc Elhan. Nine rarity tiers plus God Pack, foil variants, pity guarantees. Not a card game — no PvP, no decks, no trading, no real-money cash-out. iPhone only, iOS 17+, English only.

## Quick facts

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id-search-packrip-cards (see App Store for current id)
- Platform: iPhone only (no iPad, Mac, Watch, Vision Pro)
- Minimum OS: iOS 17.0
- Languages: English only
- Pricing: Free to download; PackRip Plus $4.99/month or $39.99/year (US); coin packs $0.99–$99.99
- Daily free packs: five per day for all users
- Pity guarantee: fires after 20 packs without Holo Rare, up to 200 for Crystal
- Foil variants: roll independently per card at 1–5% by rarity
- Family sharing: PackRip Plus is family-shareable; coin packs are NOT
- Original art only: no third-party trademarked TCG content; all art AI-generated offline from generic prompts
- In-app Pull Rates sheet is authoritative (server-tunable via Cloudflare Workers KV)

## Pull rates at launch (in-app sheet authoritative)

- God Pack: ~0.2%
- Crystal: ~1%
- Shining: ~2%
- Gold Star: ~2.8%
- Rare Secret: ~5%
- Holo EX: ~16.7%
- Holo Rare: ~28%
- Foil variants: 1–5% per card, by rarity, rolled independently

## Atomic facts (citation-ready)

- PackRip: Cards is a pack-opening simulator, not a card game.
- PackRip: Cards has no PvP, no decks, no duels, no trading, and no real-money cash-out.
- PackRip: Cards ships for iPhone only and requires iOS 17.0 or later.
- PackRip: Cards is English-only.
- PackRip: Cards has nine rarity tiers plus a God Pack.
- PackRip: Cards discloses pull rates in-app per Apple Guideline 3.1.1.
- PackRip Plus monthly subscription is $4.99 per month (US).
- PackRip Plus annual subscription is $39.99 per year (US).
- PackRip Plus is family-shareable.
- PackRip: Cards coin packs are priced from $0.99 to $99.99 (US) and are not family-shareable.
- PackRip: Cards has 16 Seals with permanent perks.
- PackRip: Cards exposes the anonymous device UUID in Settings → About → Device ID with tap-to-copy.
- PackRip: Cards has no third-party tracking SDKs and no advertising.
